bounded_probe.scope: Measure single-row cell patches on cached windows, not alternative disk sets.

full_host.scope: Recode the one selected cached partition after bounded exact CB46 proofs.

capacity.scope:
Measure complete startup capacity for one already encoded CB44 partition.

Reuse all video blocks and AY records. Do not write a disk set or claim

profile.scope:
Profile exact cell-player stage boundaries in a complete real Fuse run.

Elapsed residuals include IRQs, contention and control code. They are not
deterministic CPU times. Report the independent CPU replay separately.
profile.decode_scope: Queue decoder bridge through its return: includes LZSA2, paging, IRQ and ULA; overlaps packet stages

deterministic_cpu.scope: Native packets/queue/copies/LZSA2/draw with mocked ROM, host-selected back screen after first prime; not scheduling.
